changelog: TUN: WinTun virtual adapter with full data plane - fake-ip DNS hijack, smoltcp netstack, unified route engine (TCP/UDP)
TUN: fail-closed guarantees - capability gating, route rollback on failure, crash recovery snapshot, exit-time cleanup
TUN: fake-ip mapping persistence (fakeip.json) so apps' cached addresses resolve across restarts
TUN: strict-route hardening - private/loopback targets forced DIRECT, DNS hijack required, direct DNS bound to physical NIC
TUN: UDP proxy via TLS tunnel (FLAG_UDP frames, shared with SOCKS5 UDP ASSOCIATE)
TUN: proxy tunnel dials pre-resolved server IP so its own DNS is never hijacked (loop prevention)
Settings: new TUN panel with enable/strict-route/auto-route switches and tunable parameters
Fix: LUID-to-ifIndex conversion via system API (was breaking adapter setup); smoltcp AnyIP mode for routed traffic; socket-recycle panic in mux forwarding
